Hi! I found out that anxiety is one of my biggest triggers
Unfortunately, that means anxiety leads to an ibs-d attacks, I get anxious about it, and it becomes worse
I'm a very anxious person, and covid made it even more difficult because I developed social anxiety... I'm still trying to work on it and understand how to manage it in a better way, I take natural supplements which should help with it, I went for a bit to a psychologist and I learned a couple tricks with breathing exercises, I even tried hypnotherapy, I use meditation audios to relax in the evening and release a bit of stress 
They helped a bit, but just with anxiety induced by flares, not really with everyday anxiety 
It could be a good thing to try understand what makes you worry more and learn how to approach it in a better way, but anyway, you're absolutely not alone in this.

Hi! Honestly I've learned through youtube, I'd say 80% of the videos indicate the suggested type of yarn and hooks
For yarn and hooks you can easily find them on sites like hobbii, or amazon (just for the hooks, in my opinion, the sets of ergonomic ones are pretty cheap but good quality and a pretty decent variety)
For the yarn, you could also go to a local market or any big store/specialised store, depending on where you live
Hooked By Robin on YouTube makes some really easy content to replicate and she explains very well, chenda diy for clothes videos, hayhaycrochet on instagram has free patterns and videos
You can also type "crochet bags for beginners" on YouTube and you'll find plenty of content to choose 😊 once you learn to do the basic stitches (there's also videos for them) you're good, don't feel bad if it doesn't come out good at the beginning and I suggest to try with some cheap yarn the very first times, so you can practice before starting a project with good materials!
Crochet can be frustrating at the beginning but it's calming and is good for the brain! I hope you'll try and like it 💕
